name: agy-delegate
description: Delegate coding tasks to Google Antigravity CLI (agy) from ZCode: foreground or background runs, follow-ups in the same agy conversation, cancel, independent change evidence and execution traces. Also runs a local Anthropic-compatible model gateway so agy models can be registered as ZCode custom providers and used by native subagents.

description_i18n.en: Delegate coding tasks to Google Antigravity CLI (agy) from ZCode: foreground or background runs, follow-ups in the same agy conversation, cancel, independent change evidence and execution traces. Also runs a local Anthropic-compatible model gateway so agy models can be registered as ZCode custom providers and used by native subagents.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 在 ZCode 里把编程任务委派给 Google Antigravity CLI（agy）：前台或后台运行、在同一 agy 会话里续聊、取消任务、独立的改动证据和执行轨迹。另带本地 Anthropic 兼容模型网关，可把 agy 模型注册为 ZCode 自定义 Provider，供原生子代理使用。

agyPath.title: agy executable
agyPath.description: Command name or absolute path of agy. Empty: find agy on PATH, then %LOCALAPPDATA%\agy\bin and ~/.local/bin.

proxy.title: Proxy for agy
proxy.description: Proxy URL for agy (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890). Empty: AGY_PROXY, then <plugin data>/agy-proxy.txt, then ~/.dsh/agy-proxy.txt.

model.title: Default model
model.description: Default agy model id (see the agy_models tool). Empty: agy's own default.

effort.title: Default effort
effort.description: low | medium | high | xhigh | max, for models with effort variants. Empty: model default.

printTimeoutMs.title: Foreground ceiling (ms)
printTimeoutMs.description: Longest foreground run; capped at 780000 so one call fits the 15-minute MCP timeout. Use background runs for longer work.

skipPermissions.title: Auto-approve agy tools
skipPermissions.description: Pass --dangerously-skip-permissions. Headless agy cannot ask for approval, so real edits and commands need this.

avoidBrowser.title: Tell agy to avoid browser tools
avoidBrowser.description: Headless agy browser tools can hang a run; agy verifies by reading files and running commands instead.

addDirs.title: Extra directories
addDirs.description: Absolute directories added to every run (--add-dir), separated by semicolons.

gatewayAutostart.title: Model gateway autostart
gatewayAutostart.description: Keep a local Anthropic-compatible gateway (http://127.0.0.1:<port>) alive so agy models can be registered as ZCode custom model providers and used by native subagents. The gateway token is <plugin data>/gateway-token.txt.

gatewayPort.title: Model gateway port
gatewayPort.description: Port for the local model gateway (default 8378). Changing it requires re-registering the ZCode provider baseUrl.

supervision.title: Supervise agy tool calls (opt-in)
supervision.description: Install a command hook in each agy run that blocks writes outside the workspace and add-dirs, reads of credential/agy state paths, and denied commands (fail-closed). A guardrail, not a security boundary. Off by default.

supervisionBuiltinRules.title: Supervision: built-in command rules
supervisionBuiltinRules.description: With supervision on, also deny git push, wholesale discards (git reset --hard, git clean -f), package/release publishing, and piping downloads into a shell.

supervisionDenyCommands.title: Supervision: extra denied commands
supervisionDenyCommands.description: Case-insensitive regular expressions matched against agy run_command lines, separated by semicolons. Only used with supervision on.

supervisionStopCheck.title: Supervision: stop check command
supervisionStopCheck.description: Command run in the workspace when agy wants to stop (e.g. npm test). Non-zero exit sends agy back to fix it, up to the rework limit. Empty: no check. Only used with supervision on.

supervisionStopCheckTimeoutMs.title: Supervision: stop check timeout (ms)
supervisionStopCheckTimeoutMs.description: Longest a stop check may run (1000-600000).

supervisionMaxReworks.title: Supervision: max reworks
supervisionMaxReworks.description: How many times a failing stop check may send agy back to work (0-10).

persistentSessions.title: Persistent agy sessions (opt-in)
persistentSessions.description: Keep one streaming agy process per task alive between follow-ups instead of starting a new process per turn. Off by default; one-shot runs remain the fallback.

persistentIdleMs.title: Persistent session idle timeout (ms)
persistentIdleMs.description: Close an idle persistent agy process after this long (0 = never). Only used with persistent sessions on.
